sections.crash_profile: During {{window_start}} to {{window_end}}, {{ka_3y}} fatal or serious injury crashes and {{kabc_3y}} KABCO injury crashes occurred at this signalized four-leg intersection. The dominant crash type was left-turn opposing, with {{left_turn_opposing_3y}} crashes, followed by rear-end and sideswipe collisions. Nighttime crashes were noted, but no wet-weather crashes. Pedestrian and bicycle counts are not available.
sections.why_flagged: The site is flagged due to its model-estimated fatal or serious injury crash rate of {{fsi_rate}} per mile per year and {{annual_fsi}} fatal or serious injury crashes annually. Additional risk factors include high traffic exposure ({{aadt}} vehicles/day), a concentration of crashes within {{window_start}} to {{window_end}}, inclusion in the high-injury network, four-leg geometry, and proximity to a bar.

countermeasures.rationale: Providing a left-turn lane on one major-road approach is supported by broader evidence for KABCO injury crashes at four-leg urban signalized intersections with similar traffic volumes. The cited CMF {{cmf:267}} is a direct crash-type match for left-turn opposing collisions, but requires engineering review for prerequisites and severity scope.

Modifying change plus clearance intervals to the studied ITE 1985 practice is supported by broader evidence for all crash types at four-leg signalized intersections. The cited CMF {{cmf:380}} is a direct crash-type match, but needs engineering review for area setting and severity scope.

sections.benefit_cost: A benefit could not be computed for either countermeasure because the library lacks audit-approved CMFs with planning-level unit costs and service lives, and the severity scopes do not match fatal or serious injury crashes only.
sections.next_steps: Conduct engineering review to verify prerequisites for left-turn lane installation and signal timing modifications, including geometry, traffic volumes, and existing equipment. Confirm applicability of CMFs to site conditions and severity scope. Complete source verification for both treatments.
